factory.title: Example: add a default greeting
factory.request: Demonstrate planning only. Do not implement until the human approves the exact plan.

tasks.title: Inspect sample repository
tasks.description: Read the README, package manifest, source, tests, and feature request; infer checks from the manifest.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing greeting behavior and test command are confirmed from files.
No project scripts are run before the verification plan is approved.

tasks.title: Propose bounded implementation plan
tasks.description: Plan the default argument, focused tests, exact verification, and review steps.
acceptanceCriteria: Plan includes acceptance criteria, non-goals, file scope, and exact check command.
Plan is presented to the human before implementation.

tasks.title: Implement approved default greeting
tasks.description: Illustrative only; remain blocked until explicit approval of the exact plan.
acceptanceCriteria: Named greeting behavior remains unchanged and focused tests cover both paths.

tasks.title: Run approved verification and reviews
tasks.description: Run only the approved check, inspect actual output, and perform separate Standards and Spec reviews.
acceptanceCriteria: The exact approved test command exits successfully and evidence is recorded.
Standards and Spec findings are reported separately; failed or skipped checks are not called passed.
